paragraphs.zh: VIII. Water-Dispersible and Water-Soluble Powder
paragraphs.en: VIII. Water-Dispersible and Water-Soluble Powder
paragraphs.notes: Section heading for formulation type VIII. Roman numeral VIII read off the image.

paragraphs.zh: 75 parts by weight of form A or form B are ground in a rotor-stator mill with the addition of 25 parts by weight of dispersants and wetting agents and also silica gel. On dilution in water, a stable dispersion or solution of the active substance is obtained. The active substance content of the formulation is 75 wt. %.
paragraphs.en: 75 parts by weight of form A or form B are ground in a rotor-stator mill with the addition of 25 parts by weight of dispersants and wetting agents and also silica gel. On dilution in water, a stable dispersion or solution of the active substance is obtained. The active substance content of the formulation is 75 wt. %.
paragraphs.notes: Reads 'form A or form B' on the image, checked at 4x. Every other formulation paragraph on this page says 'form A or form C', and the claims on this page recite forms A and C, so 'form B' is anomalous. Recorded as printed and raised in discrepancies rather than corrected.

paragraphs.zh: IX. Gel Formulations:
paragraphs.en: IX. Gel Formulations:

paragraphs.zh: 20 parts by weight of form A or form C, 10 parts by weight of dispersant, 1 part by weight of gelling agent and 70 parts by weight of water or an organic solvent are ground to a fine suspension in a ball mill. On dilution in water, a stable suspension is obtained. The active substance content of the formulation is 20 wt. %.
paragraphs.en: 20 parts by weight of form A or form C, 10 parts by weight of dispersant, 1 part by weight of gelling agent and 70 parts by weight of water or an organic solvent are ground to a fine suspension in a ball mill. On dilution in water, a stable suspension is obtained. The active substance content of the formulation is 20 wt. %.
paragraphs.notes: Numbers 20 / 10 / 1 / 70 parts and 20 wt. % read off the image. The OCR layer runs words together here ('oran organic solvent').

paragraphs.en: X. Directly Usable Granules (GR, FG, GG, MG)

paragraphs.zh: 0.5 parts by weight of the form A or form C are finely ground and combined with 99.5 parts by weight of carriers. Common processes here are extrusion, spray drying or fluidized bed. Granules for direct application with 0.5 wt. % active substance content are thus obtained.
paragraphs.en: 0.5 parts by weight of the form A or form C are finely ground and combined with 99.5 parts by weight of carriers. Common processes here are extrusion, spray drying or fluidized bed. Granules for direct application with 0.5 wt. % active substance content are thus obtained.

paragraphs.zh: The application of the form A or form C or the herbicidal agents containing them is effected, if the formulation is not already ready for use, in the form of aqueous spray fluids. These are prepared by dilution of the aforesaid formulations containing the form A or form C with water. The spray fluids can also contain other components in dissolved, emulsified or suspended form, for example fertilizers, active substances of other herbicidal or growth-regulating active substance groups, other active substances, for example active substances for combating animal pests or phyto-pathogenic fungi or bacteria, and also mineral salts which are used for the elimination of nutritional and trace element deficiencies, and non-phytotoxic oils and oil concentrates. As a rule, these components are added to the spray fluid before, during or after the dilution of the formulations according to the invention.
paragraphs.en: The application of the form A or form C or the herbicidal agents containing them is effected, if the formulation is not already ready for use, in the form of aqueous spray fluids. These are prepared by dilution of the aforesaid formulations containing the form A or form C with water. The spray fluids can also contain other components in dissolved, emulsified or suspended form, for example fertilizers, active substances of other herbicidal or growth-regulating active substance groups, other active substances, for example active substances for combating animal pests or phyto-pathogenic fungi or bacteria, and also mineral salts which are used for the elimination of nutritional and trace element deficiencies, and non-phytotoxic oils and oil concentrates. As a rule, these components are added to the spray fluid before, during or after the dilution of the formulations according to the invention.
paragraphs.notes: The OCR layer capitalises 'substances' as 'Substances' in four places in this paragraph; the image is lower case throughout.

paragraphs.zh: The application of the form A or form C or of the plant protection agents containing them can be effected in a pre-emergence or in a post-emergence method. If tembotrione is less tolerable for certain crop plants, application techniques can be used wherein the herbicidal agents are sprayed using the spraying equipment in such a manner that the leaves of the sensitive crop plants are as far as possible not hit, while the active substances reach the leaves of undesired plants growing under them or the uncovered soil surface (post-directed, lay-by).
paragraphs.en: The application of the form A or form C or of the plant protection agents containing them can be effected in a pre-emergence or in a post-emergence method. If tembotrione is less tolerable for certain crop plants, application techniques can be used wherein the herbicidal agents are sprayed using the spraying equipment in such a manner that the leaves of the sensitive crop plants are as far as possible not hit, while the active substances reach the leaves of undesired plants growing under them or the uncovered soil surface (post-directed, lay-by).
paragraphs.notes: '(post-directed, lay-by)' is hyphenated across a line on the image as '(post-' / 'directed, lay-by)'; joined here. The OCR layer reads 'Iftembotri-one' for 'If tembotrione'.

paragraphs.zh: The quantities of tembotrione applied are 0.001 to 3.0 kg active substance per hectare, preferably 0.01 to 1.0 kg active substance (a.S)/ha, depending on the treatment aim, season, target plants and growth stage.
paragraphs.en: The quantities of tembotrione applied are 0.001 to 3.0 kg active substance per hectare, preferably 0.01 to 1.0 kg active substance (a.S)/ha, depending on the treatment aim, season, target plants and growth stage.
paragraphs.notes: All four numbers confirmed at 2.6x on the image: 0.001, 3.0, 0.01, 1.0. The abbreviation is printed '(a.S)/ha' with a capital S and no closing full stop, which is almost certainly a typesetting error for '(a.s.)', and is recorded as printed.

paragraphs.zh: In a further embodiment, the application of the form A or form C or the plant protection agent containing them can be effected by treatment of seed.
paragraphs.en: In a further embodiment, the application of the form A or form C or the plant protection agent containing them can be effected by treatment of seed.

paragraphs.zh: Treatment of seed essentially includes all techniques with which the person skilled in the art is familiar (seed dressing, seed coating, seed dusting, seed soaking, seed film coating, seed multilayer coating, seed encrusting, seed dripping and seed pelleting) on the basis of tembotrione in form A or C, or agents prepared therefrom. Here the plant protection agents can be applied diluted or undiluted.
paragraphs.en: Treatment of seed essentially includes all techniques with which the person skilled in the art is familiar (seed dressing, seed coating, seed dusting, seed soaking, seed film coating, seed multilayer coating, seed encrusting, seed dripping and seed pelleting) on the basis of tembotrione in form A or C, or agents prepared therefrom. Here the plant protection agents can be applied diluted or undiluted.
paragraphs.notes: Runs across the column break: it starts at the foot of the left column and finishes in the first two lines of the right column. Nine seed treatment techniques are listed.

paragraphs.zh: The term seed includes seed of all types, for example grains, seeds, fruits, tubers, cuttings and similar forms. Preferably, the term seed here describes grains and seeds.
paragraphs.en: The term seed includes seed of all types, for example grains, seeds, fruits, tubers, cuttings and similar forms. Preferably, the term seed here describes grains and seeds.

paragraphs.zh: As seed, seed of the crop plants mentioned above but also the seeds of transgenic plants or those obtained by conventional breeding methods can be used.
paragraphs.en: As seed, seed of the crop plants mentioned above but also the seeds of transgenic plants or those obtained by conventional breeding methods can be used.

paragraphs.zh: For the seed treatment, tembotrione is normally used in quantities of 0.001 to 10 kg per 100 kg of seed.
paragraphs.en: For the seed treatment, tembotrione is normally used in quantities of 0.001 to 10 kg per 100 kg of seed.
paragraphs.notes: 0.001, 10 and 100 confirmed at 2.4x on the image.

paragraphs.zh: To broaden the spectrum of action and to achieve synergistic effects, the forms A or C can be mixed and applied together with many members of other herbicidal or growth regulating active substance groups. In addition, it can be advantageous to formulate or apply tembotrione together with safeners.
paragraphs.en: To broaden the spectrum of action and to achieve synergistic effects, the forms A or C can be mixed and applied together with many members of other herbicidal or growth regulating active substance groups. In addition, it can be advantageous to formulate or apply tembotrione together with safeners.
paragraphs.notes: The OCR layer renders this marker as '0.161', turning the bracket into a decimal point. The image prints [0161].

paragraphs.notes: Every locant in this list was read off the image at 2.2x. The page prints the 3 of CF3 and the 4 and 8 of C4-C8 as typeset subscripts; recorded here as plain digits. The OCR layer read C4-C8 as 'Ca-Cs', which the image contradicts, so the image wins. The page prints 'heteroyl' in '2-(heteroyl-/aroyl)-1,3-cyclohexanediones', not 'heteroaryl'; recorded as printed. The OCR layer flattened that solidus to an f ('heteroyl-faroyl'). Hyphenation across line ends has been joined; the mid-word hyphens kept here ('halogen-carboxylic', 'meta-CF3-phenyl', 'N-phenyl-3,4,5,6-tetra-hydrophthalimides', 'S-metolachlor') are printed hyphens, not line breaks. paragraphs.zh: In addition, it can be of value to apply the form A or C alone or in combination with other herbicides also mixed with still further plant protection agents, together for example with agents for combating pests or phytopathogenic fungi or bacteria. Additives such as non-phytotoxic oils and oil concentrates can also be added.

Also of interest is the miscibility with mineral salt solutions which are used for the elimination of nutritional and trace element deficiencies. Additives such as non-phytotoxic oils and oil concentrates can also be added.

paragraphs.notes: INDEPENDENT claim, and the first live claim in the patent. Its limitations are: crystalline form A; of the named compound; X-ray powder diffraction diagram; measured at 25 deg C.; Cu-K-alpha radiation; and at least 3 of the nine listed reflections. Its dependents run on past this page. It holds NINE 2-theta values,all read off the image at 3x: 5.6+/-0.2 deg, 8.9+/-0.2 deg, 11.1+/-0.2 deg, 14.0+/-0.2 deg, 18.9+/-0.2 deg, 23.4+/-0.2 deg, 26.7+/-0.2 deg, 28.9+/-0.2 deg, 36.2+/-0.2 deg. The page prints them as running prose with no ruled table; the markdown table appended to zh and en is a normalisation so the values reach later passes, and its two columns are mine, not the page's. The chemical name is printed MALFORMED: '2-[2-chloro-4-methyl-sulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyebenzoyl]-cyclohexan-1,3-dione' has an unclosed '(' and reads 'methyebenzoyl' where claim 17 correctly reads 'methyl)benzoyl'. Recorded exactly as printed; see discrepancies. The page prints an em dash in 'Cu-K-alpha' ('Cu' em-dash 'K-alpha'), replaced by a hyphen under the repo no-em-dash rule. 'at least 3 of the following reflections' is the claim's own threshold and is three, not nine.

paragraphs.notes: Dependent claim. Dependency printed as 'claim 16', with the 16 in bold, and recorded exactly as printed. Purity limit 94 wt. % read off the image at 3x. Here the chemical name is well formed and closes every bracket, unlike claim 16's. This is the last line on the page; claim 17 is complete here, ending with a full stop, and the claims continue on p15.

discrepancies.what: Paragraph markers are printed WITH square brackets on this page, contradicting the shared vision brief, which says they are bare four-digit numbers.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The image, checked at 3x, prints bold '[0147]', '[0148]', '[0149]', '[0150]', '[0162]' and so on, square brackets included, for all 17 description markers on the page.
discrepancies.text_says: The OCR text layer at /tmp/us2010/page14.txt strips the brackets and yields '0147', '0148', '0161' (and once '0.161'), which is where the brief's rule 3 appears to come from. Recorded as the image prints them, which is also the only form that matches MARKER = ^\[\d{4}\]$ at make_visual_evidence.py:90 and PARAGRAPH_MARKER in verify.py; a bare marker is silently discarded by both. The brief's rule 3 has since been withdrawn by the run coordinator on the same evidence, so this entry is kept as the record of the correction, not as an open conflict.

discrepancies.what: Claim 16 prints a malformed chemical name; claim 17 prints the same compound correctly. The claim's scope depends on the name, so this is recorded and not repaired.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Claim 16, as printed: '2-[2-chloro-4-methyl-sulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyebenzoyl]-cyclohexan-1,3-dione'. The '(' before 2,2,2 is never closed, 'methye' is missing the 'l)', and 'methyl-sulfonyl' and '-cyclohexan' carry hyphens that claim 17 does not.
discrepancies.text_says: Claim 17, as printed: '2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione'. This is the well formed name and is the same compound, tembotrione.

discrepancies.what: Paragraph [0148] specifies form B, where every other formulation paragraph on the page and both claims on the page speak of forms A and C.
